prose: DeepSeek has raised roughly $15 billion (about 100 billion yuan) in its latest fundraising round, one of China's largest ever, with battery giant CATL and Tencent among the biggest contributors, Bloomberg reports citing sources. The round would cement DeepSeek's position as China's flagship AI lab with backing from national industrial champions.
highlights: DeepSeek raised ~$15B (~100B yuan), one of China's largest rounds ever, per Bloomberg sources
CATL and Tencent are among the biggest contributors
The round pairs China's flagship AI lab with national industrial champions
